notes.title: Mark Out 1.0.0 Release
notes.notes:
🎉 Mark Out - Official Release Announcement! 🎉

Hey there, wrestling fans and card game enthusiasts! I'm beyond excited to announce that my passion project, "Mark Out," has officially left Early Access! After a fantastic journey in Early Access since August 2021, the game is now ready for you to jump into the ring and experience strategic wrestling action like never before. This will be the final update for Mark Out as I finally get to exhale from all of my hard work.

I've poured my heart and soul into "Mark Out" since 2019, handling all the programming, systems, and implementation myself. I couldn't have done it without the support of my amazing community, who has been there every step of the way. Your patience and feedback during Early Access have been invaluable in shaping the game into what it is today.

But I didn't do this alone! I've had the pleasure of working with some incredibly talented artists, sound designers, and texture creators, who have brought the game to life with stunning visuals and immersive audio. Together, we've created a gaming experience that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

And now, the wait is over! Development for "Mark Out" is officially complete, and I'm thrilled to bring you the full version of the game. Get ready to unleash your creativity because "Mark Out" is packed with tools that allow you to make it your very own wrestling sandbox. From designing your own signature moves in the Move Editor to crafting unique wrestler stances with the Pose Creator, from creating custom wrestling matches with the Match Creator to designing your own wrestlers in the Create a Wrestler feature — the power is in your hands!

I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to each and every one of you who has supported me throughout this incredible journey. Your feedback, encouragement, and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind "Mark Out's" development. This game is for you, and I hope it brings joy and excitement to your wrestling-loving hearts.

So, what are you waiting for? Grab your copy of "Mark Out" to embark on a thrilling adventure of strategic gameplay, intense matches, and unforgettable moments. Let's step into the ring together and make some legendary memories!

Thank you all for your incredible patience and for joining me on this fantastic ride. I can't wait to see you inside the squared circle!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.6.3 AVAILABLE NOW
notes.notes:
It has been quite some time since I have posted a formal update description, but I think now is the perfect time. Since the last update, there have been quite a few adjustments.

[b]New Card Types[/b]
There are 2 brand new card types that work together.
[list]
[*] Body Part Target Cards
[*] Heal Cards
[/list]
In order to heal specific body parts from damage, you must combine a Heal card with the appropriate Body Part Target card. All of these cards can be found in the Loose Cards section of the store.

[b]Wrestling and Card Types[/b]
Up until version 0.6, Card Types were merely aesthetic. Cards did not behave differently based on them being Submission, Powerhouse, Highflying, etc. Well, that is no more! Each wrestler now comes with their  own wrestling style that can be set in the Create a Wrestler bio screen. Your wrestling style will now also affect the cards that you use. For instance, a Powerhouse wrestler will not be rewarded as handsomely for using a Highflying card opposed to a Powerhouse card. The buffs are small for now, but I'd love to see how this alters gameplay going forward before making adjustments.

[b]New Wrestlers[/b]
Back in 2015, I made a commitment to local wrestlers in Detroit that I would put them in a wrestling game. Back then, I was not equipped with the knowledge or resources to do so. With the reception of Mark Out so far, I though it the perfect time to finally bring these characters into the game. There are a total of 6 wrestlers, each with their own wrestling style. Since these models were crafted years ago, these wrestlers are not editable. Along with the wrestlers, there is a brand new XICW arena inspired by the local Detroit promotion.

I hope that you all enjoy these updates as we continue to target the 1.0 release. Some things I want to tackle next are:
-Cleaning up poses that look wonky since replacing character models
-Adjust/Create SFX for weapons
-Replace fans with different models
-Add commentary
-Add Story Mode (1.0) release

If you see anything urgent before then, please alert me!

notes.title: Version 0.5.0 Is Now Available
notes.notes:
Wheeeew! This is the longest time I have EVER gone between updates and for good reason. My primary goal for this update was to move the needle on the Create a Wrestler mode. 

[h1]Create a Wrestler/New Character Models[/h1]
I was sick and tired of those old beatdown Mark Out model and the limitations if afforded the Create a Wrestler mode. Under 10 hairstyles was also an unacceptable benchmark that I was not willing to accept for long. I'm excited to say that I am MUCH happier with where the Create a Wrestler mode is today. Take a look at some of the new renovations made to the mode:
[list]
[*] Brand new character model with 100+ morphs
[*] 20+ hairstyles
[*] Existing facial hair that properly morphs with character
[*] The ability to add designs and custom textures to boots
[*] Gym shoes x2
[*] Single limb dependent pads and bands
[*] 3D Shirts
[*] 3D Pants/Shorts
[*] 3D Masks
[*] Reference image importing
[*] Common color storage
[/list]

[h1]Card Innovations[/h1]
Once I felt comfortable with these changes, I moved my focus over to card management. I reached out for feedback on the modifiers and found out that many of you do not care to waste a deck space on them. This prompted me to create a way for you to fuse cards OUTSIDE of matches, permanently turning 2 cards into 1 and potentially 3 into 1.

[h1]GOAT Card Crafter[/h1]
The next area of focus was finding a way to make cards feel special. I seem to have come up with a unique but grind-based way for players to unlock cards of the GOAT tiers. These cards will no longer be capable of being found in card packs. Instead, players will be tasked with collecting 3 cards per GOAT card. Once all 3 of those cards are collected, you can trade them in for a GOAT card. This actually turned out to be a pretty fun and more destination based way of collecting cards. I look to build on this in the future by showing an indicator of how many cards you have collected of the 3. 

[h1]Card Hunting[/h1]
This lead to the next added feature. While messing around, I realized that it was nearly impossible to easily keep track of what cards I needed to find. To address this issue, I came up with a Card Hunting system. The system works like this:
[list]
[*] In the collection, you hit the "HUNT LIST" button
[*] This will add the card in question to your hunt list (obviously)
[*] As you open packs and collect cards, the game will listen to see if you have collected the card from your hunt list
[*] If you have, you will be alerted
[/list]

Known Bugs to be addressed in the future:
[list]
[*] Card Hunt does not properly alert after manually opening a card pack
[*] Some new poses need to be adjusted to account for the new character models
[*] Some Modifier cards were added to the Atypical tier but still show their legacy tier backgrounds
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.4 Version Available
notes.notes:
I honestly did not expect to whip out such big updates back to back, however...my excitement for this project overtakes me each day. In the last big update, I mentioned the addition of Steel Chairs inside of matches. The 2 match types introduced at that moment were the First Blood and Hardcore matches. After some of your awesome feedback, I released that the First Blood match was slightly broken and needed some more attention.

[b]LADDER[/b]
I used yesterday to address this match type and even decided to add a Brand New match type in the process. New to Mark Out is the Table Match!!! This match requires you to train your opponent's spirit to 0. Doing so will put your opponent through the table. I also have an idea to make matches like this a bit more spontaneous with cards that allow you to attempt a quick victory. I'm still finalizing that concept. In addition to this update, you now have access to over 20 brand new Table cards. Currently, these cards can be access by purchasing and innovating with the Table Modifier Card.

[b]HUD[/b]
I spent a good amount of today making several tweaks to the Wrestler HUD. The HUD will now only show health bars that are applicable to your current match type. In addition to this, Body part Spirit will differ from Overall Health. This will reward players that choose to use a Strategy to win versus someone that just spams random moves. You will also notice that the Spirit meter has been repurposed as the Momentum meter. Total spirit will now be displayed in a new slider above the rest of the body part spirit.

[b]BODY PART DAMAGE[/b]
Several bugs were addressed in regards to the Card Creator. You now also have the ability to edit Combinated Cards to set a target body part.

Bugs
[list]
[*] Issue fixed that gave blank starter card packs for new players
[*] Issue fixed that showed "1" after winning with a submission
[*] Issue fixed that showed incorrect fill amount with body part spirit meters
[/list]

notes.title: 0.4.0 Version Available
notes.notes:
With update 0.4.0, I wanted to start refining some of the existing features of the game. The game's formula was pretty simple with the Momentum, Energy, and Spirit field's being key pillars of gameplay. As I started playing the game myself and even watching players get into it, I began to think of ways further expand this current system. 

[b]Gameplay Pillars[/b]
The original update saw the Reversal system being completely overhauled pretty early in the game's development. The players of the game really seemed to enjoy that update! The next issue I addressed was the player's inability to hit more costly cards without the need to pass on turns excessively. To account for this, the energy system was rehauled to refill each turn you had, This completely opened up gameplay and finally allowed players to use those stronger cards. The most recent (0.4.0) update focuses on the Spirit system. Originally, you would just throw out cards to get the one value to 0 regardless to the match type. The game now features body part targeting for cards along with individual body part spirit. This new update allows for more strategy in different match types such as Submission (requires you to work a body part to cause Submission) and First Blood (requires you to work head to cause blood). The next pillar that I plan on revamping is the Momentum system. Currently, it is very difficult to obtain a finisher and lame if I can be honest. I have some ideas in mind to bring that feature to the forefront of development soon.

[b]New Match Types[/b]
This updates includes 2 brand new match types being First Blood and Hardcore. Both of these matches will allow the use of the new chair cards with the difference being First Blood's requirement of Head Targeting. These matches are in the experimental phase, so please play and break these.

[b]Steel Chairs[/b]
Steel chairs have entered the chat! This new update introduces a brand new card modifier that can be purchased from the store call Chair Modifier. Purchase these modifiers, add them to your decks, and see what moves can be innovated real-time. These cards will not currently show in the Card Catalog as I just realized (while typing) that I forgot to assign the cards to Tiers. They are still usable and very effective nonetheless. These chairs can be used in the new Hardcore and First Blood matches and spell the beginning of the Weapon integration for Mark Out. I'm aware of the slow-down you experience when looking at potential innovations included for this card and will address it soon with a revamped Innovation viewer.

[b]Blood[/b]
This feature was not highly recommended, but with the addition of weapons coming soon, I wanted to get this out of the way. Blood can now be triggered by certain moves if the head is damaged enough. The exception to this is the First Blood match that prevents blood until the Head Spirit is at 0.

[b]Fighting Back[/b]
I have personally been a fan of the amazing Fighting Back organization and what they do in their fight against Pancreatic Cancer for a little bit now. It was so amazing to see the community rally around this cause and really come together last year to hit the huge donation goal. To do my part in spreading awareness for the cause, I worked with the organization to Craft a completely brand new arena in the game. This Fighting Back arena can be claimed upon game entry. In addition to this, all Mark Out card backgrounds will temporarily be branded with a custom made Fighting Back skin. I hope that you all enjoy this as much as I did creating it and please be sure to check out the org on Twitter today @FightingBack613

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom Cards would not upload with custom wrestlers leading to blank cards in matches.
[*] Mark Out Moment cards have temporarily been disabled. I want to go back to the drawing board here to better refine the use of these.
[*] Sometimes, cards that should not be available in matches would pop up in Submission matches
[*] Cards that were upgraded after being added to a wrestler's deck would create duplicate cards
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.3.5 Out now!
notes.notes:
This has by far been the longest gap between updates since the release of Mark Out! This is due to the complete overhaul I had to do with the existing Grind Mode. I received a TON of feedback requesting the ability to use Workshop characters in grind mode and for the ability to wrestler at more than the stock 3 promotions. Well...

[u][b]Promotion Creator and Grind Mode[/b][/u]
GREAT NEWS! This new update allows you the opportunity to choose an existing wrestler before heading into the Grind Mode. Along with this, you also now have the ability to create your own CUSTOM PROMOTIONS. These promotions allow you to choose custom artwork, build a roster from scratch, and even schedule your weekly shows and PPVs. After building out your dream promotions, head on over to the Grind Mode to activate them.

[u][b]Pose Crafter[/b][/u]
So far, 2 key bugs were addressed dealing with the Ring Rope data not reflecting correctly and the weapons not morphing correctly as intended.

[u][b]Online Mode[/b][/u]
Online is one of the more experimental features in the game. There are so many things that could go wrong, not even taking into account my potential mess ups. This new update should now block off sessions that are full. There was also a bug related to moves being reversed that was a gamebreaker. This issue has now been addressed and should be resolved for you all also.

[u][b]The Future[/b][/u]
There is still so much that I need and want to add to this game. We are still just scratching the surface with this project. Future updates will focus on Create a Wrestler content and a brand new Create an Arena mode!

notes.title: Version 0.3.4 Is Now Available
notes.notes:
This is a baby patch that I put together while I get my 9-5 work week started. This build does the following:
[list]
[*] Introduces a very buggy Online system. It is so buggy that Sessions can not be locked out after match is full (looking into solution tonight)
[*] Improvements to the reversal system that allows you to see the card in question, along with a new reversal pop up
[*] A new energy system that resets on each turn while adding 1 for a max of 10 energy resource
[*] Plus some smaller improvements to hopefully make your experience better
[/list]

Expect more information about the progress of the online system, Create a Wrestler mode, and 2 BRAND NEW Creative Modes soon to hit development. My primary goal this week is to fine tune overall gameplay, clean up as many bugs as possible, and refine the Day 1 features before moving too far forward. 

For quick feedback, bug reporting, and questions, head to the Discord here:
https://discord.gg/E2reV3MY

Thanks again for all of your support, feedback, and patience throughout this process. As a solo dev, you guys make me feel like this game has more potential than I ever thought it could. I can't wait to add new match types, match modes, and crazy features for you all.
